newsitem.title: POLAND: HANDLOWY SEES LDA NET DOUBLING IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: HANDLOWY SEES LDA NET DOUBLING IN 1996.

text.p: The brokerage of Polish Bank Handlowy SA sees printing house Lodzka Drukarnia Akcydensowa SA (LDA) net soaring to 1.1 million zlotys in 1996 and to 1.5 million in 1997, up from 0.5 million in 1995, Handlowy said.
It said in a report dated August 30 that the company was likely to record sales of 33 million this year and 41 million next year, up from 26.8 million in 1995.

It said the expected growth of earnings was due to the predicted growth of demand for LDA's products, their good quality and strengthening position of the firm on the domestic market. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
